query_text: Create a dumbbell chart showing, for each value-chain segment with at least five companies, the gap between that segment’s share of all companies and its share of all disclosed funding, using `Total raised` converted to `$B`, with segments sorted by the absolute size of the gap.
sort_rule: descending by absolute gap between company share and funding share
selection_rule: segments with at least five companies

plot_config.title: Segment share of companies vs disclosed funding

reasoning_summary: Counted each segment’s share of all companies.
Summed disclosed funding by segment and converted that to share of disclosed funding.
Computed absolute gaps and sorted segments by gap size.
